nodes.prompt: Heavy rains are expected in 3 days. Your rice crop needs protection.
nodes.voicePrompt: तीन दिन में भारी बारिश आने वाली है। आप क्या करेंगे?

nodes.prompt: The rains came but your insurance covered 80% of the damage. Great decision!
nodes.voicePrompt: बीमे ने 80% नुकसान कवर कर लिया। शानदार फैसला!
nodes.lesson: [Skill Tested: Insurance Literacy] Crop insurance costs a small premium but protects you from losses 10x larger.

nodes.prompt: Your crop survived but now you owe ₹8,000 at 30% interest to the moneylender.
nodes.voicePrompt: फसल बच गई लेकिन साहूकार को 30% ब्याज पर ₹8,000 देने होंगे।
nodes.lesson: Moneylenders charge 25-30% interest. Formal bank loans are only 7%. Always choose formal credit.

nodes.prompt: The rains destroyed 60% of your crop. Without insurance, you have no fallback.
nodes.voicePrompt: बारिश ने 60% फसल नष्ट की। बीमा न होने से भारी नुकसान।
nodes.lesson: Without savings or insurance, one bad season can push a family into poverty.
